snippet.title: TUNED IN 📺 Gameplay trailer | An horror full experience available now for free: The Prologue
snippet.description:
🎮 Tuned In: The Prologue. A full experience available now to play for FREE: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4967470/Tuned_In_The_Prologue/

🟢 Coming soon on Kickstarter https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/vercorsgames/tuned-in-an-original-horror-game-based-on-a-cursed-tv?ref=byq3qr

Tuned In is an original horror game based on a cursed TV, developed by Vercors Games, a team made up of former senior developers from Tequila Works (RIME, GYLT, Song of Nunu: A League of Legends Story...), along with talent from Airship Syndicate and Blizzard.

📺  About Tuned In 📺 
Trapped by a dark entity within a cursed television broadcast, you must survive its sinister lineup of puzzles, layered with multiple shades of horror, and face impossible decisions. You will encounter or impersonate other survivors through a branching story where your mastery of an old TV controls determines who escapes to freedom. All the while, reality and television signals bleed into one another.

Although there’s still a lot more to uncover about Tuned In in the coming weeks, we promise you an engaging, ever-shifting anthology of nightmares. Each story draws from a different horror sub-genre, giving it its own distinct identity, from the gritty, heavy-ink shadows of a slasher to the muted, grainy textures of atmospheric folk horror all brought to life through a striking, visceral graphic novel aesthetic.
